flora: Microscopic algae (as thick, vibrant green and teal blooms in shallow water)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the swirling, cloud-like textures of the algae in the water; vibrant, saturated 'emerald' and 'teal' colors; water has a soft, inviting translucency; focus on the contrast between life and the harsh salt-crusted environment.

visual_logic.composition: A high-angle close-up looking down into a shallow, turquoise ephemeral pool on the playa. Vibrant swirls of algae create abstract patterns in the water, contrasting with the salmon-colored silt at the pool's edge.
visual_logic.ground: Fine-grained pinkish-red siltstone submerged beneath clear, algae-tinted water, with white salt crystals forming at the waterline.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright sun reflecting off the water surface and the white salt crusts, creating a high-key, sparkling tropical-arid feel.
